description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Water with Stacking], [Physical Blink Stacking 2], [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode], [Crystal Force Mode: Yuffie (Water)] to the user

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Physical Blink Stacking 2
description.text: Allows to stack Physical Blink, up to Physical Blink 2

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Yuffie (Water)
description.text: Ninja abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ninja abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode
